summary: MODEL_CHANGE_REQUIRED: leader commit now uses Engine::update_progress over an order-sensitive VecProgress; reference/MC/Trace/Update suite and harness updated; 17 fresh traces validated; MC-1 (commit without a joint quorum, leading to committed-log divergence) found by model checking and reproduced at the Engine level.
validation_limits: Model checking is bounded (3 servers, small term/index/action budgets, <=4 in-flight messages); time-bounded BFS/simulation runs did not exhaust their queues.

HandleUpdateMatched early-return/ReplicationState, DeliverAppendEntries, RejectAppendConflict, the voter side of GrantVote and Crash are validated only through Engine-level constituents, not by direct traces.
OneOutstandingMembership is checked only in crash-free configurations (pre-existing restart mismatch, identical on the V0 model).
Harness builds use cargo +stable because the pinned nightly-2022-03-30 toolchain is unavailable.
MC-1 is reproduced at the Engine API level (real entry points in runtime order); a multi-node cluster reproduction was not attempted.

Two pre-existing model defects were repaired (stale ReplicationState across leaderships; follower membership/truncation abstraction) and one pre-existing property mismatch (OneOutstandingMembership under restart) was scoped; all are recorded in spec/changelog.md.
The specula ci-result command is not installed in this environment; generated CI reports were not produced.

findings.title: Leader commits an entry without a quorum of every joint-membership group
findings.cause: VecProgress::update stores a value in place without move_up when prev > committed, leaving the vector unsorted; the recompute counts vector[0..=i] as a quorum of ids holding vector[i]. The update made this the leader commit path, and upgrade_quorum_set makes the unsorted case reachable after a membership append.
findings.trigger: 3 voters, leader n2: n1 acks index 0 (committed), n2 proposes next_safe joint [{1,2,3},{1,3}] at index 1, only n3 acks index 1.
findings.consequence: An entry is committed and applied without a majority of every joint group; with a voter-adding joint config a stale leader can commit a different entry at an index already committed by a newer leader (CommittedLogAgreement violated in the directed 5-server model run).

premises: Leader commit is computed by Engine::update_progress over Leader.progress (VecProgress).
